crew.overview: A cold and mysterious new security guard for a Los Angeles cash truck company surprises his co-workers when he unleashes precision skills during a heist. The crew is left wondering who he is and where he came from. Soon, the marksman's ultimate motive becomes clear as he takes dramatic and irrevocable steps to settle a score.
crew.title: Wrath of Man

crew.overview: Four undying warriors who've secretly protected humanity for centuries become targeted for their mysterious powers just as they discover a new immortal.
crew.title: The Old Guard

details.biography:
Sofian is a qualified stunt performer, represented actor and member of the British Stunt Register. He has worked on a multitude of television shows, movies and commercials in both capacities. He is a boxer & avid equestrian who has utilized firearms, vehicles and hand to hand combat on a variety of projects. Taken a variety of hits and reactions as well as having performed stunts in water, at height and on horseback.

He has been a stunt double for the likes of:

Idris Elba Page Kennedy Guz Khan Rege Jean Page Martins Imhangbe Corey Hawkins Laz Alonso O'shea Jackson Jr Damson Idris Sarunas Jackson Sope Dirisu Ken Nwosu Sherman Augustus & Common

As an actor he has featured in the likes of: Treason - Netflix, Eastenders - BBC, Bulletproof - Sky One, Total Excellium - Commercial, Big Boys Don't Cry - Netflix, London Heist - Sky, Street Fighter Resurrection & Epiphany and more...
details.name: Sofian Francis
